svg.aria-label: AgentRQ workflows: you drag the release workspace onto the deploy_finished event. claude finishes the qa task, so qa_passed fires and a pulse runs into deploy, which gets a new task; codex deploys, deploy_finished fires and release gets its task; hermes writes the release notes and claude, codex and hermes celebrate.
